meta.title: Rejecting during bidding is refused where the round disables it
gaps: The client setting disable_reject_bid_in_bidding_time cannot be set or verified with the available vocabulary.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Bid rejection is disabled while bidding is in progress”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Rejecting during bidding is refused where the round disables it

expected.message: Bid rejection is disabled while bidding is in progress
